verses.text: This is the message of judgment against Moab. In one night Ar in Moab is destroyed and ruined. In one night Kir in Moab is destroyed and ruined.
The people go up to the temple and to Dibon, to their high places, to weep. Moab cries over Nebo and Medeba. Every head is shaved bald, and every beard is cut off.
In the streets they wear sackcloth. On the rooftops and in the town squares everyone cries out, weeping bitterly.
Heshbon and Elealeh cry out. Their voices are heard as far away as Jahaz. So the soldiers of Moab cry out, and their hearts tremble inside them.
My heart cries out for Moab! Its people run away to Zoar, as far as Eglath Shelishiyah. They go up the hill to Luhith, weeping as they go. On the road to Horonaim they cry out over their destruction.
The waters of Nimrim are dried up. The grass has dried up, the new grass is gone, and nothing green is left.
So they carry away the riches they have gained and stored up, across the Valley of the Willows.
Their cries are heard all around the borders of Moab. Their weeping reaches as far as Eglaim and Beer Elim.
The waters of Dimon are full of blood, but I will bring even more on Dimon: a lion to attack those of Moab who escape, and those who are left in the land.
